title: Order Card
content:
The Order Card component simplifies placing orders on TopstepX. Traders can select Buy or Sell, Market, Limit, Stop Market, Trailing Stop orders, and options such as Join Bid, Join Ask, Close Position, Reverse Position, Cancel Orders, Flatten All, and Cancel All.
